basis: Malignancy occupying bone or articular cartilage; other organs depend on the individual tumour and extent.
PAX6-related foveal maldevelopment with visual impairment, nystagmus and cataracts; unrelated grandparent entries do not establish other involvement.
Hereditary infantile peripheral axonal neuropathy; no evidence establishing direct damage to additional organs.
Carcinoma arising in the pituitary endocrine gland and producing ACTH; additional organ damage is not established across patients.
Defining skeletal dysplasia; hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%. Sleep apnea is separately diagnosed; spinal narrowing alone does not establish neurologic damage.
Heme synthesis disorder with characteristic cutaneous phototoxicity. Liver failure affects ~5%; anemia is variable and not clearly above 30% here.
Dysferlin-related muscular dystrophy directly damages skeletal muscle; reduced reflexes do not establish a separate peripheral neuropathy.
Superficial Malassezia infection of skin; systemic infection is an uncommon presentation in a selected population.
Scalp aplasia and limb/skull defects define AOS. Cardiac defects and hydrocephalus each annotated 30-79%; ocular defects also 30-79%, omitted under cap.
Congenital posterior fossa and fourth ventricular malformation; visual symptoms and papilledema can reflect hydrocephalus without intrinsic eye disease.
Micronodular disease of the adrenal cortex; no evidence establishes additional direct organ damage.
Diffuse carcinoma deposits directly occupy the peritoneum, an abdominal serosal structure; the originating organ varies.
Umbrella of inherited mineral transport and metabolism disorders; additional organ damage varies substantially among subtypes.
Defining cerebral arteriopathy and hypogonadism; neurologic ischemic events in 5/7 and cataracts in 4/7 support brain and eye involvement.
Squamous carcinoma arising in the bladder urachal region; bladder belongs to the renal axis.
Polyomavirus infection directly affects cutaneous hair follicles; underlying immunosuppression does not establish additional disease involvement.
Ichthyosis, keratoderma and deafness in 3/3; developmental delay in 2/3 and structural limb damage including talipes/digital autoamputation in 1/3.
Disordered proximal tibial growth produces infantile tibia vara and associated skeletal abnormalities.
Congenital abnormal lung tissue separated from normal lung; anomalous arterial supply alone does not establish cardiovascular damage.
Adenocarcinoma originating in thyroid follicular cells; the thyroid is an endocrine gland.
Facial cutaneous vascular tumours and a skin raphe define the syndrome; frequencies of associated sternal and aortic malformations are unspecified.
Genetic epileptic encephalopathy with developmental impairment; visual impairment in 1/2 does not establish intrinsic ocular damage.
Central movement disorder causing dystonia; dysphagia and blepharospasm do not establish direct gastrointestinal or ocular tissue damage.
Sensory neuropathy and severe neurodevelopmental impairment define disease; keratitis, fractures and osteomyelitis are secondary, separately diagnosed complications.
Motor and sensory axonal neuropathy; structural muscle loss with distal amyotrophy in 3/3, supported by fatty replacement and foot deformities.
